referenceNotes: Attack availability depends on recovering the thrown blades.
Outgoing speed is 15; return speed is 3.75.
S1 bounce radius is 1.7; prefer untouched targets, then nearest targets. Bounce travel speed is 6.
webMappingLimits: S1 times is mapped to additional bounce transitions after the primary hit. Repeat fallback clears the local recent-hit memory; native callback ordering is unverified.

S2 forward motion uses the native moveAheadSpeed in tile units for the selected duration. Outbound damage is trace-only; return collision uses a swept radius-0.5 circle and one hit per victim. Native phase/trajectory dispatch is unverified.

S3 counts three born projectiles in a volley; the last successful hand arrival checks the current source deployment and active S3 before the selected capped tile AoE. Native all-return dispatch, curved trajectories, VFX and exact frame ordering are unverified.
Projectile lifetime ends owned work and gating. Native final trace hits apply only to previously unhit original victim lives. Expiry is not a successful hand return.
